messages.subject: Error in secr.fit
parts:
Hello everyone !

We are working with secr.fit function in order to calculate roe deer densities in Switzerland. The following error appeared fitting the model for a subsampling of the data with less recaptures than with the whole data set. My question is : Does this error mean that the number of recaptures is not enough to calculate densities through secr models? 

Error in secr.fit(sb, mask = clippedmask, model = list(D ~ 1, g0 ~ bk,  :
  too few values session 1 to determine start;
set manually or select different session with details autoini

Thank you in advance !

Amael

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error in secr.fit
parts:
Strictly, it just means what it says - that the automatic procedure could not find starting values for likelihood maximisation. This can happen even if there are enough data overall (i.e. across all sessions). See 'Failure of autini' in secr-multisession.pdf.
Murray
